key_findings: TLR4 and p-p65 are upregulated in spinal dorsal horn microglia after nucleus pulposus implantation in a rat lumbar disc herniation model.
TLR4 antagonist TAK242 and NF-κB inhibitor PDTC relieved pain, reduced microglial activation and shifted cytokines (lower IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α; higher IL-10).
